newsitem.title: INDIA: Reserve Bank of India to abolish exporters' code.
newsitem.headline: Reserve Bank of India to abolish exporters' code.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Thursday exporters would no longer be required to obtain an RBI code.

"In order to avoid duplication and to simplify the system of allotment of code numbers, it has been decided to dispense with the requirement...and instead adopt the import-export code number issued by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (GGFT) for monitoring export of goods and fulfilment of exporters' obligations under the exchange control regulations," it said.
All exporters should now mention the code given by DGFT in all correspondence with the RBI, it said.
